text: Assessing the sufficiency of information by rulemakers alone can lead to suboptimal results because path dependencies may lead decision-makers to believe they control sufficient information for rulemaking when in fact they do not.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Law Dynamic Regulation in a New Institutional Economics Framework (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2267560

isBasedOn.name: Evolution of Law Dynamic Regulation in a New Institutional Economics Framework

abstract: The sufficiency of information in this model, if assessed by rulemakers alone, could lead to suboptimal results. Path dependencies may lead decision-makers to believe they control sufficient information for rulemaking when they in fact do not.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: sufficiency of information assessed by rulemakers alone
